about_the_game:
The content is still in production and improving. This demo is mainly to let players feel the game flow; feel free to leave some feedback in the comment area :D

Background

I met a devil who wants to play a game with me.

We will flip coins until one shows tails.

Once that happens, I can keep all the coins except for the one showing tails.

All I need is to pay some coins in return.

Sounds like a good deal, doesn't it?

The game

I flip a coin.

If heads, automatically flip another coin and repeat the process until tails.

If tails, I gain all the coins except for the one showing tails, and the round is over.

For every 5 rounds, the devil will charge me some coins.

Can't wait to become a millionaire!

Devil's offer

Every time the round is over, the devil offers three items for sale.

I can use the coins I earned from the previous round to purchase those items.

Those items will make my next round better!

The devil is too kind for me!

content_descriptors.notes:
The content of the game will show the player's blood splash in the form of a trade with the demon.
Players might discover that the item's description contains a slight sexual innuendo.
Players may find that the icons and descriptions of the items do not shy away from showing drugs, alcohol, and tobacco.
